title: This Squid Flies 100 Feet Through the Air

scenes.text: This squid flies through the air for 100 feet.
The neon flying squid blasts water out of its body like a rocket.
That shoots it out of the ocean, then it spreads its fins and arms like wings.
It glides more than 30 metres in about three seconds.
That's over 11 metres a second, faster than an Olympic sprinter.
A squid that flies. Faster than you.

description:
Japanese researchers filmed flying squid blasting out of the ocean and gliding more than 30 metres, about 100 feet, in roughly three seconds.
They hit about 11 metres per second using their fins and arms as wings.
Would you believe a squid can fly if you hadn't seen it?
first_comment: Bonus: researchers in Japan caught it on camera in the wild. Which animal would you least expect to fly?
